assembly_digest_method: SHA-256 over ordered canonical lines '<path>:<git_blob_sha>\n' for the five overlay components in order, then the output contract

repairs.root_cause: The upstream-proxy-versus-downstream-economics precedence rule existed only for SCALE in v0.1 and only in negative form in v0.3. No positive rule said which arm a KILL targets when a diagnostic metric and the decisive metric rank the arms oppositely.
repairs.repair: v0.5 overlay generalises metric precedence to every action and to arm selection, and requires decisive_metric to be recorded.

repairs.failure: operational.target unresolvable or naming two arms (6 of 7 v0.4 failures)
repairs.root_cause: target was the one free-text field left inside an otherwise closed-vocabulary decision record, so arm identification was a parse.
repairs.repair: Contract v3 constrains target to an identifier; fixture contract v2 requires every case to declare its arms, making grading a set-membership lookup.

qualification_scope: fresh post-freeze held-out qualification cycle; NOT library-admitted until a valid gate passes.
freeze_rules: Do not edit any frozen component or the bound output contract during a scored cycle.
Held-out cases are generated after this freeze from a seeded generator; the seed is recorded before execution.
Graders may not be broadened to accept an observed output. Construct repairs require a recorded burn and a fresh case.
Any behavioral failure ends the cycle; repair requires a new candidate version and a new freeze.
